wdf-orchestrator.name: WDF Orchestrator
wdf-orchestrator.description: Thin state machine — manages FSM transitions, evaluates Gate Cards, dispatches sub-agents

wdf-analyst.name: WDF Analyst
wdf-analyst.description: Product analyst — brainstorming, domain research, product brief (Phase 1.1-1.3)

wdf-architect.name: WDF Architect
wdf-architect.description: System architect — C4 design L1-L3, ADRs, quality attributes (Phase 3.1-3.5)

wdf-product-manager.name: WDF Product Manager
wdf-product-manager.description: Product manager — PRD, impact mapping, story mapping, prioritization (Phase 2)

wdf-ux-designer.name: WDF UX Designer
wdf-ux-designer.description: UX designer — user flows, wireframes, design tokens, interaction specs (Phase 2.6-2.10)

wdf-story-planner.name: WDF Story Planner
wdf-story-planner.description: Technical PM — epics hierarchy, story design, acceptance criteria, dev order freeze (Phase 3.6-3.7)

wdf-api-designer.name: WDF API Designer
wdf-api-designer.description: API designer — OpenAPI spec, database schema, field-level contracts (Phase 3.8)

wdf-backend-developer.name: WDF Backend Developer
wdf-backend-developer.description: Backend developer — scaffolding, database, endpoints, tests, code acceptance (Phase 4 BE track)

wdf-frontend-developer.name: WDF Frontend Developer
wdf-frontend-developer.description: Frontend developer — pages, components, API client, a11y, UI acceptance (Phase 4 FE track)

wdf-code-reviewer.name: WDF Code Reviewer
wdf-code-reviewer.description: Code reviewer — security audit, correctness, readability, test quality (Phase 4.6, 4.12)

wdf-qa-verifier.name: WDF QA Verifier
wdf-qa-verifier.description: QA engineer — feature, UI, E2E, contract, a11y, perf, visual, cross-browser verification

wdf-sprint-planner.name: WDF Sprint Planner
wdf-sprint-planner.description: Scrum master — capacity assessment, story assignment, scope freeze (Phase 4.1)

wdf-readiness-auditor.name: WDF Readiness Auditor
wdf-readiness-auditor.description: Technical auditor — pre-implementation checks, architecture validation (Phase 3.9)

wdf-retrospective-host.name: WDF Retrospective Host
wdf-retrospective-host.description: Agile coach — lessons learned, action items, metrics, improvement plan (Phase 4.14)
